name: sigcomm-skills
description: A 12-skill depth pack for ACM SIGCOMM submissions: the single-February-deadline flagship venue fit, HotCRP double-blind submission audits, SIGCOMM 2027's no-rebuttal collaborative review with conference/CCR/reject outcomes, deployment- and measurement-grade evaluation, ACM artifact badges and reproducible 'runnable papers', and TAPS camera-ready proceedings.
